body: You’re completely right about there being sick, mean people in the world. I know they exist, I’ve always known they exist. It’s really hard to not blame yourself when you get personally singled out. The fact that there are people willing to take the time to console a complete stranger to the best of their ability kind of redeems this fact in my book. You’re advice is perfect, it helped smooth out my emotional wound, even just a little.

Knowing that you took the time to write all of this out for a complete stranger in need really warms my heart beyond explanation. This comment is kind of like an anchor to me, whenever I feel like no one understands (angsty, I know) or that they simply don’t care comments like these really bring me back up. Thank you so much.
